landing.heroTitle: The anonymous way to be reachable when your car needs you.
landing.heroSubtitle: A QR sticker on the windshield. We alert you instantly, without ever revealing your number.
landing.heroCardScanText: Scan the sticker and reach them
landing.heroCardAlertText: They'll easily send you an alert
landing.heroAlt: CarLink QR sticker on a car windshield
landing.problemsTitle: Every day, drivers face these problems
landing.problemsSubtitle: A small issue can become a big headache when you can't reach the owner. CarLink makes it simple.
landing.problem1Text: Someone parked in your spot or blocked your exit? With CarLink, they can be notified in seconds.
landing.problem2Text: A dent, a scratch, an accident? Witnesses can instantly contact you with details.
landing.problem3Text: Your headlights are still on and your battery is draining. A passerby can alert you before it's too late.
landing.problem4Text: Rain is coming or theft risk is high. Someone can warn you immediately.
landing.problem5Text: Interested in buying the car? Leave your contact instantly — no need to leave a paper note.
landing.problem6Text: Charging station occupied and you need to charge? Contact the owner to estimate their return.
landing.problemsCtaText: Don't let small issues become big problems.
landing.howSubtitle: Three simple steps to protect your vehicle and stay connected. No app to download, no complicated setup.
landing.how1Title: Stick the QR on your car
landing.how1Text: Print your QR code and stick it on your vehicle's windshield.
landing.how2Text: They scan the QR with their phone, choose WhatsApp or SMS, and send a message — without ever seeing your number.
landing.how3Text: The message arrives in your CarLink space. Reply directly via WhatsApp or SMS.
landing.howPhoneDoneCopy: The owner has received your message.
landing.howTrustText: Your visitors don't need to install anything. They just scan and send.
landing.advNumberNote: You get the message — nobody sees your number.
landing.advTitle: The smart advantage of being reachable
landing.advSubtitle: More than a QR code — a complete, private and instant way to stay in touch with your car.
landing.adv1Text: Your phone number is never revealed. You stay 100% anonymous to every visitor.
landing.adv2Text: Get notified in real-time the moment someone contacts you about your vehicle.
landing.adv3Text: Anyone can scan and send a message. No download, no sign-up — it just works.
landing.adv4Text: Receive messages on your favourite channel and reply directly from it.
landing.adv5Text: Protect all your cars with a single account and a QR code per vehicle.
landing.adv6Text: Regenerate or deactivate a QR code anytime — your contact stays in your hands.
landing.reachTitle: We reach you in more than one way
landing.reachSubtitle: Receive alerts by SMS message or an anonymous alert call, depending on your plan. SMS uses mobile signal; the anonymous call needs an internet connection.
landing.reachSmsText: The warning reaches you as a direct text message.
landing.reachCallText: The warning reaches you as an anonymous call, so the caller's number stays hidden.
landing.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about CarLink. Can't find your answer? Contact us.
landing.faq1A: Someone scans the QR code on your vehicle and sends you a message. You instantly receive an alert by SMS or anonymous call — no personal data is ever shared.
landing.faq2Q: Do I need to install an app?
landing.faq2A: No. CarLink works entirely in your browser. Visitors just scan the QR and type their message; you manage everything from your dashboard.
landing.faq3Q: Is my phone number visible to visitors?
landing.faq3A: Never. Your number and personal details stay completely hidden. Every message is routed through CarLink without revealing your identity.
landing.faq4A: Plans start at 20 TND for a single vehicle, with packages for multiple vehicles and businesses. See the Pricing page for details.
landing.faq5Q: Can I regenerate or deactivate my QR code?
landing.faq5A: Yes, anytime. You keep full control of your QR codes and can regenerate or deactivate them directly from your dashboard.
landing.legalPrivacySubtitle: How CarLink protects your data and your privacy.
landing.legalPrivacySection1Title: Who we are and what this policy covers
landing.legalPrivacySection1Text: CarLink ("we", "us" or "our") provides anonymous QR contact for vehicles in Tunisia. This policy explains what personal data we collect when you visit the website, order a sticker, create an account, register a vehicle or receive alerts, why we use it, and the choices you have. It applies together with our Terms of Use and Communication Policy.
landing.legalPrivacySection2Text: We collect only the data needed to operate the Service:
landing.legalPrivacySection2Item1: Account: your name, email address, password (stored only as a salted BCrypt hash) and the phone number registered for alerts.
landing.legalPrivacySection2Item2: Vehicles and stickers: vehicle details, order details and one-way SHA-256 hashes of sticker tokens (raw tokens are never stored).
landing.legalPrivacySection2Item3: Activity: reports, message content shown in your dashboard, alert delivery status and timestamps.
landing.legalPrivacySection2Item4: Technical: your IP address and request metadata, used in short-lived counters for rate limiting and security.
landing.legalPrivacySection3Text: We use personal data to operate and secure the Service: to create and authenticate your account, activate stickers, relay alerts from scanners to you, show your conversations in the dashboard, fulfil and deliver orders, enforce fair-use limits, prevent abuse and fraud, provide support, and comply with legal obligations. We do not use your data for advertising, profiling or automated decisions that affect your rights.
landing.legalPrivacySection4Text: A person who scans your sticker never sees your name, phone number, email or address. The QR code carries only a random token; the public page shows the alert form and never exposes owner identity. Your phone number is used solely to deliver the alerts you have enabled.
landing.legalPrivacySection4Text2: Alerts are delivered by SMS through our messaging provider, which necessarily receives your phone number to route the message. Message content is visible to you in your authenticated dashboard; we do not log message content, phone numbers or raw QR tokens in application logs.
landing.legalPrivacySection5Text: We do not sell or rent personal data. We share it only with service providers that process it on our behalf and under contract: hosting and database infrastructure, a messaging provider for SMS delivery, and an email provider for transactional email. We may also disclose data where required by Tunisian law, a valid legal request, or to protect the rights, safety and security of users, the public or CarLink.
landing.legalPrivacySection5Text2: Aggregated, non-identifying statistics (for example, the number of scans) may be used to understand usage and improve the Service.
landing.legalPrivacySection6Text: Passwords are hashed with BCrypt and are never stored or logged in clear text. Sticker tokens are stored only as SHA-256 hashes, so a database leak cannot be used to reconstruct sticker URLs. Authenticated endpoints verify ownership before returning conversations or vehicle data, and administrative access to reports is restricted to authorised administrators.
landing.legalPrivacySection6Text2: We use TLS/HTTPS in production, short-lived access tokens, rate limiting on public pages, QR lookups, reports, guest orders and sign-in attempts, and least-privilege access to production systems. No system is perfectly secure, but we review these measures as the Service evolves.
landing.legalPrivacySection7Text: We keep personal data for as long as your account is active and for the period needed to provide the Service. When you delete your account or ask us to erase your data, we remove or irreversibly anonymise it, except where we must keep records to meet legal, tax, accounting or security obligations. Rate-limiting counters and technical logs are kept only for short periods.
landing.legalPrivacySection8Text: You can access, correct and export your account and vehicle data from the dashboard, and you can delete your account there or by writing to us. You may also object to or restrict certain processing and withdraw consent for optional communications at any time.
landing.legalPrivacySection8Item1: Access and export: download your account and vehicle data from the dashboard.
landing.legalPrivacySection8Item2: Correction: update your profile, phone number, vehicles and alert settings at any time.
landing.legalPrivacySection8Item3: Deletion: delete your account or ask us to erase your data.
landing.legalPrivacySection8Item4: Complaint: contact us first; you may also lodge a complaint with the Tunisian data-protection authority (INPDP).
landing.legalPrivacySection9Text: We use only what the Service needs to work: a token that keeps you signed in, your language preference, and a local draft of an unfinished sticker order. We do not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies. You can clear this data from your browser at any time, though you will be signed out and any unfinished order draft will be lost.
landing.legalPrivacySection10Text: The Service is intended for people who can enter into a contract under Tunisian law. It is not directed to children, and we do not knowingly collect their personal data. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, contact us and we will delete it.
landing.legalPrivacySection11Text: We may update this policy to reflect changes to the Service, the law or our security practices. We will update the date above and, for material changes, give additional notice in the dashboard or by email. Questions about this policy or your data can be sent to hello@carlink.app.

By creating an account, activating a sticker, scanning a QR code, or using the website, dashboard, alerts, or related services (the "Service"), you agree to these terms, our Privacy Policy and our Communication Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.
landing.legalTermsSection1Text2: You must be legally capable of entering into this agreement. If you use the Service for another person or entity, you confirm that you have the authority to bind them to these terms.
landing.legalTermsSection2Text: CarLink provides a private way for people to reach you when something is wrong with your vehicle. QR stickers link to registered data and deliver alerts from whoever scans to the owner through the dashboard and the enabled contact channels. The Service is a communication channel only; it is not an emergency, towing or security service, and it is not a substitute for contacting the police, ambulance, fire department or the relevant authorities.
landing.legalTermsSection2Text2: Delivery may depend on the internet, mobile carriers, messaging platforms, hosting and other providers. We do not guarantee that every scan, alert or SMS will be delivered, or delivered immediately.
landing.legalTermsSection3Text: You agree to provide accurate information, keep your login credentials secure, and update your contact and alert details promptly. You are responsible for activity on your account and for having the right to register and describe every item or vehicle linked to it.
landing.legalTermsSection4Text: Access is subject to fair-use limits: the public pages are limited to 5 visits per minute per IP address, each QR code to 20 lookups per hour, anonymous reports to 10 per minute per IP address, and guest orders to 5 per minute per IP address. Five failed sign-in attempts lock the account for 15 minutes. We may suspend or restrict activity that exceeds these limits or that appears automated, fraudulent or abusive.
landing.legalTermsSection4Text2: You must not use the Service to:

landing.legalTermsSection4Item2: send spam, unlawful content, malicious software, misleading reports or repeated abusive alerts.
landing.legalTermsSection4Item3: attempt to discover the private contact details of an item's owner, bypass limits, probe security without authorization, collect data automatically, or disrupt the Service.

landing.legalTermsSection5Text: Plans, prices, features, renewal terms and taxes are shown before you subscribe or renew, and alert limits remain subject to the fair-use rules above. Unless the checkout or offer clearly states otherwise, creating an account alone does not authorize automatic charges. Any payment, cancellation, refund or renewal terms presented at the time of purchase form part of these terms, together with any mandatory consumer rights.
landing.legalTermsSection6Text: CarLink, its software, designs, texts, marks and original content are protected by intellectual-property laws. We may restrict, suspend or terminate an account, sticker or access where reasonably necessary because of abuse, fraud, a security risk, a legal obligation, non-payment or a breach of these terms. Where practicable, we will notify you and give you an opportunity to remedy the issue.
landing.legalTermsSection8Text: The Service is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis to the extent permitted by law. We do not warrant uninterrupted or error-free operation, the recovery of any item, the prevention of harm, or the successful delivery of any message.

landing.legalCommsSubtitle: How and when CarLink contacts you.
landing.legalCommsSection1Text: This policy explains how CarLink communicates with you: the alerts you receive when someone scans your sticker, notifications in your dashboard, and essential service emails. It complements our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
landing.legalCommsSection2Text: We send only the messages needed to run the Service:
landing.legalCommsSection2Item1: Contact alerts: an SMS when someone scans one of your stickers and leaves a report.
landing.legalCommsSection2Item2: Dashboard notifications: the same reports, plus status updates for your account, stickers and orders.
landing.legalCommsSection2Item3: Service emails: verification, password resets, order confirmations and important account or security notices.
landing.legalCommsSection2Item4: Optional updates: product news only if you have explicitly opted in.
landing.legalCommsSection3Text: Alerts are delivered by SMS to the phone number registered on your account. Reports and their content are also available in your authenticated dashboard, and transactional messages are sent by email. We do not use WhatsApp or social messaging for alerts at this time, and we do not make marketing calls.
landing.legalCommsSection4Text: Each alert is triggered by a scan of your sticker and is subject to the fair-use limits of your plan: 20 lookups per QR code per hour and 5 visits per minute per IP address on public pages. Alerts are delivered only to you; the person who scanned your sticker never sees your number.
landing.legalCommsSection5Text: Promotional or non-essential messages are sent only with your explicit consent. You can withdraw that consent at any time from your dashboard or by contacting us, and withdrawing it never affects alerts or essential service messages.
landing.legalCommsSection6Text: Some messages are essential to the Service and are sent whenever your account is active: email verification, password resets, order and delivery updates, security notices and changes to our policies. You cannot opt out of these while you keep an account, because they protect your account and your sticker.
landing.legalCommsSection7Text: You decide how CarLink reaches you:
landing.legalCommsSection7Item1: Phone number: update the number that receives alerts in your dashboard at any time.
landing.legalCommsSection7Item2: Alert settings: enable or disable alert channels for each vehicle and sticker.
landing.legalCommsSection7Item3: Language: choose the language used for emails, SMS and the interface.
landing.legalCommsSection7Item4: Unsubscribe: opt out of optional updates while keeping essential service messages.
landing.legalCommsSection7Item5: Deletion: delete your account to stop all communications.
landing.legalCommsSection8Title: No sharing of your contact details
landing.legalCommsSection8Text: We never share your phone number or email address with the people who scan your stickers. To deliver an SMS, our messaging provider receives your number solely to route that message, under contract and only for that purpose.
landing.legalCommsSection9Text: SMS delivery depends on your mobile carrier, network coverage and the messaging provider. We do not guarantee that every alert will arrive, or arrive immediately, and an alert is not a substitute for emergency services.
landing.legalCommsSection10Text: Reports and conversations remain available in your dashboard while your account is active, and are deleted or anonymised when you delete your account. Questions about this policy can be sent to hello@carlink.app.

about.heroTitle: A small sticker that connects drivers, honestly.
about.heroSubtitle: CarLink was born from a simple frustration: not being able to reach a driver when you need to — or not wanting to reveal your number when someone reaches you. We build tools that keep you contactable without giving up your privacy.
about.originText1: One evening, a driver found their car blocked by another vehicle. No owner in sight, no way to call them, and no paper note — just hours of waiting. That night, the question was simple: what if a parked car could tell you how to reach its owner without revealing their number?
about.originText2: We set out to build exactly that: a QR sticker, a private relay, and instant alerts. No app to install, no personal data exposed, no subscription — just a smarter way to be reachable when your car needs it.
about.valuesSubtitle: Four principles guide every decision we make.
about.value1Text: Your phone number and personal data are never shared. Anonymity is a feature, not an afterthought.
about.value2Text: No app to download, no complicated setup. If it takes more than 30 seconds, we haven't finished our job.
about.value3Text: One-time pricing, no hidden fees, no forced subscriptions. What we promise is what you get.
about.value4Text: Every driver who helps another keeps our roads — and our shared spaces — kinder.
